items.quote: Tasa Selford took ownership of service-level targets for frontline operations and steered it to completion.
Tasa Selford championed evidence-based evaluation of programme outcomes and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
They championed delivery under pressure through a demanding year-end peak and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
They set the direction for the partnership with sister agencies on youth services across the public service.
Tasa championed incident management during the ransomware attack and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
They participated in the migration of core services to the cloud as a team member.
They was recognised sector-wide for their leadership of presentations to senior management.
Tasa led engagement with industry stakeholders across the department.
Tasa Selford drove root cause analysis of recurring service failures for the whole division.
